terms.p: A failure that a correct program will meet in normal operation and that the caller can sensibly act on, which is what Result is for.
What a panic does by default: it returns through every frame in turn, running the destructor of each live value, so locks are released and files are closed on the way out.

terms.p: A short description attached to an error as it passes up through a layer, so the final message says which file was being read rather than only that something was missing.
A crate that generates the Display and Error impls for your own error enum, leaving the type concrete so callers can still match on its variants.
A crate giving applications a single boxed error type that any error converts into, plus a chain of context strings for the human reading the message.
